title: Amgen Scholars Program
about: Summer research program for European undergraduates at Institut Pasteur, July 1 to September 3, 2027. The application site opens November 1, 2026 and closes February 1, 2027; results expected in April 2027.
requirements: Undergraduates at a university in a Bologna Process country, in the second year of a three-year bachelor's or second/third year of a four-year integrated program
Must attend the full program, including the September 2027 symposium in Cambridge
English-language check by phone may be required
Official transcript, recommendation letter and personal statement
card_alt: Card for the Amgen Scholars Program, a life-sciences summer research internship at Institut Pasteur in Paris, France, with an application deadline of 1 Feb 2027. The photo is an aerial view of the Eiffel Tower between the Palais de Chaillot and the Champ de Mars gardens, with the La Défense towers on the skyline.
